{"sql":"SELECT vendor_invoice_no, COUNT(DISTINCT ap_doc_id) AS doc_count
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor_bill
WHERE period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY vendor_invoice_no
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap_doc_id) > 1","purpose":"Find vendor invoice numbers booked under more than one ap_doc_id in September 2026"}
